opening_hours.quote: We're open 5am to 10pm weekdays and 7am to 7pm weekends.

quiet_hours.quote: the floor is quietest weekdays before 8am and after 7pm

other_locations.quote: Southside Strength Co. operates from Bentleigh, with sister gyms in Cheltenham and Mordialloc.

has_online.quote: We do not currently offer online or remote programming.

books_classes.quote: Members book through the app, or we can book them in at the desk over the phone if they'd rather.

renewal_discount_percent.quote: Members on a fixed term who renew before their expiry date get 15% off their first month of the new term.

reengagement_perk.quote: For current members we haven't seen in a while, you can give them a guest pass to bring a mate in.

winback_offer.quote: Anyone whose membership has lapsed is eligible for one free personal training session on rejoining.
